input: Find nature, outdoor adventure, farm, wilderness, climbing, paddling and fishing summer camps and summer programs for kids and teens in or near Asheville, NC (every part of the city: downtown, West, North, South and East Asheville). Search the web thoroughly (several searches with different wording and town names) and list every organization you find.
searches: Asheville outdoor nature summer camps 2026 climbing paddling farm
Asheville 2026 summer camp climbing Cultivate Climbing Riveter

candidates.name: Adventure Center of Asheville
candidates.note: Adventure day camps and Kolo Bike Park camps with outdoor challenges and mountain biking.

candidates.name: Forest Floor Wilderness Programs
candidates.note: Weeklong nature-connection day camps at three locations; teen wilderness overnight camp.

candidates.name: Growing Wild Forest School
candidates.note: Nature-immersion summer camps for ages 3–8 with forest exploration and creek play.

candidates.name: The North Carolina Arboretum
candidates.note: Weeklong Discovery Camps focused on outdoor exploration; 2027 details forthcoming.

candidates.name: Cultivate Climbing
candidates.note: Weeklong climbing camps with coached instruction, games and creative activities.

candidates.name: The Educational Garden Project
candidates.note: Garden Camp for ages 6–10 and CIT program for ages 11–16; gardening, animals and cooking.

candidates.name: Asheville Parks & Recreation
candidates.note: Multiple city summer camps, including outdoor Adventure Camp; 2027 information due February 1.

candidates.name: YMCA of Western North Carolina
candidates.note: Outdoor Adventure day camp, other summer day camps and overnight Camp Watia near Bryson City.

candidates.name: Camp Cedar Cliff
candidates.note: Christian day and overnight camps with climbing, trail rides, ropes courses and rafting.

candidates.name: Asheville Farmstead School
candidates.note: Camp Farmstead offers themed farm-and-forest summer day camps.

candidates.name: Ruby Ranch
candidates.note: Working-ranch outdoor day camp for ages 6–16 with gardening, creek exploration and horseback riding.

candidates.name: Fiddlehead Farm & Forest
candidates.note: Full-day summer camps with climbing, biking, games and exploration; formerly The Riveter.

candidates.name: Town of Fletcher Parks & Recreation
candidates.note: Summer day camp includes creek days, nature activities, swimming and farm and park field trips.

candidates.name: NovusWay
candidates.note: Lutheridge summer camps for children and youth include trails, swimming and campfires.

candidates.name: Camp Rockmont
candidates.note: Christian boys’ camp for ages 7–17 with outdoor adventures and nature excursions.

candidates.name: Camp Merri-Mac
candidates.note: Christian girls’ overnight summer camp for grades 1–11 with outdoor adventure and horseback riding.

candidates.name: Camp Timberlake
candidates.note: Christian boys’ overnight summer camp for grades 1–11; summer campus is in Marion.

candidates.name: Camp Grier
candidates.note: Age-progressive overnight camps with hiking, canoeing, climbing and wilderness trips.

candidates.name: Green River Preserve
candidates.note: Nature-focused overnight camps and teen expeditions with backpacking, paddling and climbing.

candidates.name: Eagle's Nest Foundation
candidates.note: Eagle’s Nest Camp and local nature-adventure additions combine wilderness activities, riding and arts.

candidates.name: Gwynn Valley
candidates.note: Coed overnight camp with farm, wilderness and traditional camp programs; 2027 registration announced.

candidates.name: Camp Carolina
candidates.note: Boys’ sleepaway summer camp for kindergarten through grade 11.

candidates.name: Rockbrook Camp
candidates.note: Girls’ outdoor-adventure sleepaway summer camp for ages 6–16.

candidates.name: Camp Pinnacle
candidates.note: Overnight outdoor-adventure camp with boating, swimming, archery and nature activities.

candidates.name: Camp Highlander
candidates.note: Coed residential camp for ages 6–16 with canoeing, kayaking, hiking, climbing and ropes courses.

candidates.name: Camp Mondamin
candidates.note: Boys’ camp for ages 6–17 emphasizing paddling, wilderness trips, climbing and horseback riding.

candidates.name: Camp Green Cove
candidates.note: Girls’ summer overnight camp with riding and outdoor trips included in its sessions.

candidates.name: Falling Creek Camp
candidates.note: Boys’ overnight outdoor camp with junior, two-week and longer sessions; 2027 registration announced.

candidates.name: Talisman Camps
candidates.note: Adventure camps for youth with autism, ADHD and learning differences; programs begin at age 6.

candidates.name: North Carolina Council of Trout Unlimited
candidates.note: Rivercourse overnight fly-fishing and cold-water conservation camp for ages 12–15 at Lake Logan.

candidates.name: Camp Celo
candidates.note: Farm-based overnight camp with animal care, gardening, hiking, camping and South Toe River activities.

candidates.name: Camp Merrie-Woode
candidates.note: Girls’ wilderness summer camp with boating, climbing, backpacking, horseback riding and arts.

candidates.name: Bravo: Blue Ridge Adventures – Vision Optional
candidates.note: Five-day overnight adventure camp for blind or visually impaired youth with rafting, climbing and hiking.

candidates.name: YMCA of Greenville
candidates.note: Camp Greenville provides overnight adventure camps for kindergarten through high-school ages.

candidates.name: Blue Ridge Council, Scouting America
candidates.note: Camp Old Indian’s 2026 Scout summer program includes outdoor skills and high-adventure activities.

candidates.name: Harvey Family Farm
candidates.note: Flower-farm nature camp with guided observations, nature crafts, STEM activities and creek exploration.
